trap-nonspeakable.notes: THREE RIGOR FLAGS. (1) The per-block ratio does check out: with G^q diagonal entries dim_q(V) dim(V)/[n]_q! and the classical limit dim(V)^2/n!, the ratio per block is (dim/dim_q)([n]_q!/n!), exactly the bracket in the parent's boxed formula. So the arithmetic of the formula is internally consistent. (2) INCONSISTENT WEDDERBURN WEIGHT within this chapter: this proof uses dim_q(V) dim(V)/[n]_q!, while the proof of prop:full-pole-structure-mass-trace uses w_lambda(q) = dim_q(lambda)^2/[n]_q!. The two agree at q = 1 and differ everywhere else; at most one is the Markov-trace Gram weight. (3) THE PROJECTION STEP IS ASSERTED: 'the relevant determinant projects onto the rank-2 sublattice spanned by beta_s, beta_w, factoring over the Wedderburn blocks weighted by character coefficients' is the only step that produces the exponent c^(s) c^(w), and it is stated without argument. A rank-2 determinant becoming a product over all partitions with those exponents is exactly the step a reader cannot reconstruct.
